caption:
A Navi Mumbai port just moved more containers in a single month than ever before. Breaking its own record from just one month earlier.

Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority handled 834,697 TEUs in September 2026 - its highest-ever monthly container volume, up 28.63% year-on-year, edging past August's record of 831,956 TEUs. Total cargo handled was 9.90 million tonnes, up 18.39%. For H1 FY27, JNPA handled 4.66 million TEUs, up 17.61%, and climbed from 28th to 21st in Alphaliner's global container port ranking.

A port doesn't make headlines the way a rocket launch does. But every record it breaks shows up in prices, not photos.

Sources: Maritime Gateway, India Shipping News (2026)
